Welcome to Eva Vets Pet Clinic 🐾❤️ — your trusted destination for quality veterinary care and pet health information. We currently have 3 centres in Dehradun, Haridwar and Saharanpur, providing caring and professional services for your beloved pets.

On this channel, you’ll find useful videos about dog care, cat care, pet health, vaccination, nutrition, common pet diseases, preventive care, grooming, pet parenting and veterinary advice. Our goal is to help pet parents understand their pets better and provide them with a healthier, happier life.

📍 Our Centres: Dehradun | Haridwar | Saharanpur

Subscribe to Eva Vets Pet Clinic for practical pet-care tips, veterinary guidance and helpful information for every pet parent.

Eva Vets Pet Clinic — Caring for Pets, Supporting Pet Parents. 🐶🐱❤️
